description: La Route de l’Huile d’Olive à Nyons – Jeu de données is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vivre à Nyons. This dataset lists the points of interest linked to the Route de l’huile d’olive in Nyons and its nearby territory: oil mills, producers, olive estates, tasting places and heritage sites related to olive cultivation. Coverage: Vivre à Nyons. The portal shows the English title as "The Route de l’Huile d’Olive in Nyons – Dataset" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vivre à Nyons. Its keywords include degustation, huile-d-olive-aop, moulins-a-huile, patrimoine-oleicole, tourisme-culturel. The listing shows 2 download or service links in KMZ. The listing shows 2026-01-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
